title: Differential Pressure Sensor Zero-Span Electronic Calibration
description: Intermediate pharmaceutical engineering module investigating differential pressure sensor zero-span electronic calibration.
learning_objectives: Master professional Conditionals in Instrument Tuning in pharmaceutical engineering and cleanroom automation
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in differential pressure sensor zero-span electronic calibration
Demonstrate precision in GAMP 5, CSV, and regulatory inspection compliance

questions.prompt: If the cleanroom differential pressure _____ below 15 Pascals, the SCADA alarm triggers a visual red beacon.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('drops') for automated physical rules.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use 'will' in the conditional if-clause.
explanations.wrong_C: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'dropped' forms an unreal condition, mismatched with present 'triggers'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Never use 'will' in conditional if-clauses (*If pressure will drop*). Use Present Simple: 'If pressure drops'.
